scope_limits: Both published executables and the relevant implementation are identical; this is the named shipped-pair qualification, not an implementation-delta claim.
Real SIGKILL occurs after acknowledged durable mutations. No mid-transaction cut, cold boot, power-loss or physical fsync durability is claimed.
